**Newsletter from the Founder**

Starting May 8, our print shop accepts recycled paper! We encourage artists to bring a sample to try our new eco-friendly options. Let's celebrate sustainability together!

Dear Art Community,

Starting May 8, our print shop accepts recycled paper for all your projects. We're excited to support artists by offering sustainable materials. Please bring a sample to try out our new eco-friendly options. Thanks for choosing us!
